title: These Words Are Making Your Resume Look Weak 😱 #SHORTS
description:
These Words Are Making Your Resume Look Weak 

Recruiters skim your resume for about 7 seconds.

So the words you use need to grab attention, fast.

 Words like “team player”, “fast learner”, and “detail-oriented” sound nice…
but they don’t prove your impact.

They show who you are as a person, not why you’re the best fit for the role.

And phrases like “assisted with” or “familiar with”?

They scream vague and forgettable.

 Instead, use power words that show real ownership and achievement:

Executed
Launched
Managed
Increased / Decreased
Coordinated
Implemented
Facilitated
Established
Consolidated
Piloted
Boosted
Generated X revenue / profits

Follow for proven tips to write a standout resume and get hired faster!
